basic_info.description: Welcome home to 427 Spruce Street!    Just steps to the Presidio and the many boutiques, cafes & restaurants along Sacramento St and Laurel Village, this spacious bi-level top floor residence with 4 generous bedrooms & 3.5 bathrooms has it all!  The gracious entry landing opens to the grand high-ceilinged double parlor featuring a sunny living room w/fireplace & beautifully restored Victorian mantle and pocket doors opening to the expansive formal dining room.   The state-of-the art kitchen features professional grade appliances, abundant custom cabinetry, breakfast nook and center island with counter seating opening to the family room with built-in media center and pocket doors offering optional separation.    A bedroom, full bathroom, home-office, laundry room, powder room and coat closet complete this level.     Stairs lead up to a massive primary suite with walk-in closet, spa-like en-suite bathroom, wood-burning fireplace, built-in shelving/media space and walk-out decking.   2 additional bedrooms, a luxe full bathroom, numerous sky-lights, multiple closets and extensive storage complete this level.    Gorgeous wood floors, dual-paned windows, designer lighting, fire & security alarm, shared rear yard interior access to garage/work space, wine storage & much more...
